plans.countingQ: Which products count towards my subscription?
plans.countingA: For the subscription price, LIVO counts the products you place on the EU market yourself, such as own brands and own imports. faq.title: Good questions. Clear answers.
faq.lead: You do not need to have your whole process worked out to take a first step.
items: Can I start with my own Excel?
Yes. LIVO proposes how your columns map to the data in the register. You review and confirm the import. In the demo we show how that works and discuss your current files.
Does LIVO automatically e-mail suppliers?
LIVO prepares the request; you send it from your own mailbox. That can be a link to the supplier portal or a prefilled Excel file. You keep the contact with your supplier yourself.
What if my supplier has not answered yet?
Then that remains an open item. LIVO helps make visible what is still missing, so you can follow up specifically and do not give your customer certainty that is not there yet.
Are evidence documents included in the Excel export?
The customer selection contains the data. The evidence documents are not included as attachments in that Excel file. So agree separately which documents your customer needs and how you share them.
Do I automatically meet the PPWR with LIVO?

LIVO supports your work with data, obligations and evidence. Your organisation remains responsible for the assessment and the decisions. The software gives no legal guarantee that a product meets every requirement.
I do not know exactly what I need yet. Can I still start?
Start with the question on your desk now. In a demo we look at the workflow with fictional data and discuss your range, available features and a suitable next step.

about.title: About LIVO APPS
paragraphs: European rules on packaging, sustainability and deforestation ask a lot of SMEs. You have to collect data, keep track of obligations and translate complex legislation into your own products and processes. Many small teams do not have the time or the specialist knowledge for that.

At the same time, customers, suppliers and producers ask each other for data and evidence. Spreadsheets and documents travel back and forth through the whole chain, often by hand. That takes a lot of work, while it is hard to see what is correct and what is still missing.

That is why we started LIVO. We build software that makes the work lighter for SMEs. We build knowledge of the rules into the app, so you can see which data is still missing and what the next step is. We started with packaging (PPWR) and are working on a module for deforestation-free products (EUDR).

costs.title: When PPWR stays manual, the bill keeps growing.

items.title: It takes too much time.
items.body: Checking, chasing, updating and rebuilding answers quickly turns PPWR into ongoing manual work.

items.title: Customer requests become a commercial risk.

costs.transition: PPWR is ongoing work. When it stays manual, time, rework and customer pressure keep adding up.

changes.title: Built to make ongoing PPWR work easier to manage.
changes.benefit: Save time. Share the work. Keep everything together. Know where you stand.
changes.lead: From the first import onwards, the workflow helps you fill gaps, manage changes and maintain a complete product file.

features.title: Your Excel. No rigid template.
features.body: Start with the files you already have instead of reshaping everything first. LIVO reads the structure, asks when it is unsure and remembers the format. The preview shows what will change before anything is saved, and re-imports update instead of duplicating. Export works the same way, so your data is never locked in.

features.title: Know where you stand.
features.body: See what is complete, missing, expired or still open, per product and per market, with obligations mapped out to 2040. Evidence carries an expiry date; when it expires, it stops counting on its own. Less checking by hand, and fewer surprises when a customer asks.

features.title: Let suppliers do part of the work.
features.body: Send a prefilled request from your own mailbox: a secure link to the supplier portal, or a prefilled Excel per supplier. In the portal, suppliers see what you already know and fill in only the gaps; their answers come back as proposals for you to review and confirm. In an Excel, a supplier can also change known values; you import that file yourself and LIVO flags changed known values as tasks.

features.title: Keep the file complete and up to date.
features.body: Keep packaging data, evidence and status together, so changes are easier to manage. Generate the declaration of conformity and the technical documentation from the same maintained source, with an append-only attestation trail behind it. Entering, confirming and signing are separate rights, held by the people you designate.

cycle.title: Let suppliers fill the gaps.
cycle.lead: You send the request; LIVO prepares it. In the portal, suppliers fill in only the gaps and every answer comes back as a proposal for your review. A returned Excel you import yourself, even where known values were changed.

steps.title: Prefilled request
steps.body: LIVO prepares a request per supplier with everything you already know filled in.

steps.title: You send it
steps.body: A secure link or a prefilled Excel, sent from your own mailbox. LIVO does not e-mail your suppliers for you.

steps.title: Supplier fills in
steps.body: In the portal only what is missing, with plain-language explanations of each field. In an Excel, the supplier can also adjust known values.

steps.title: Proposed updates
steps.body: Portal answers land as proposals that you review and confirm. A completed Excel you import yourself; changed known values are flagged as tasks.

forWhom.title: Four questions to see whether this is your work.
forWhom.lead: PPWR assigns obligations by role, per product and per market. These questions help you see where you stand.

cards.title: Own-brand manufacturers
cards.body: Your name on the box makes you the manufacturer. Is the file per product ready to stand behind, with the evidence to back it?

cards.title: Importers
cards.body: Packaging you bring into the EU is yours to answer for. Do you have the supplier data and proof for every product you import?

cards.title: Wholesalers and distributors
cards.body: For the subscription price, your own brands and imports count; what you resell is registered without counting. Your obligations depend on your role for each product and market. Do you know which of your products that is?

cards.title: Logistics and fulfilment
cards.body: The box you fill and the pallet you wrap are your packaging. Do you know which role PPWR gives you, per flow, and what your customers will ask for?
